name: Outdoor Biome & Weather Proving Strip
entranceDescription: the Outdoor Biome & Weather Proving Strip

triggers.label: Wash Garments in Stream
triggers.tooltip: Cleanse and scrub all fluid stains and soiling from worn and carried clothing.
triggers.description: A clear, rushing stream flowing over smooth river pebbles.

triggers.label: Airlock Teleport Sigil
triggers.tooltip: Step onto the transit rune to instantly return to Test Hub (1, 1).
triggers.description: An enchanted copper rune pad pulsing with teleportation magic.

defaultDescriptions: A continuous outdoor proving strip engineered with diverse environmental biomes, weather gradients, and encounter pools.
The atmosphere and soil transition distinctly beneath your feet as you advance along the biome sectors.

0,1: The western terminus threshold leading back into the Validation Proving Grounds central district.
A sturdy stone archway marks the boundary between the proving concourse and the outdoor strip.
1,1: Towering pine trees and thick ferns blanket this section in cool, dappled forest shadow.
Twigs snap underfoot amidst pine needles and mossy roots.
2,1: Fallen marble pillars and cracked flagstones evoke the crumbling corridors of the Sunken Ruins.
Damp stone masonry covered in creeping ivy and ancient glyphs.
3,1: Reinforced wooden palisades and iron brazier tripods simulate a frontier outpost garrison perimeter.
Compact gravel pathways and watchtower scaffolding frame the mock outpost boundary.
4,1: Dark volcanic pumice and smoldering soot drifts form a barren ashland tract beneath a smoky haze.
Jagged obsidian crags and heat fissures rise from the arid basalt ground.
5,1: Rough subterranean limestone walls curve overhead, dripping with cool mineral runoff.
Damp stalagmites and dark rock alcoves form an authentic cavern environment.
6,1: A fast-flowing river sluice cuts through the testing lane with clean, pristine water.
Stone washing steps descend directly into the crystal-clear running stream.
7,1: A cozy timber cottage mockup with rustic furnishings and cedar shingles.
Polished floorboards and wooden window frames model an interior residential homestead.
8,1: The eastern terminus apron before the reinforced airlock of the Validation Research Facility.
Brass hydraulic pipes and gleaming steel bulkheads seal the research laboratory entrance.

forest: Dense simulated woodland featuring towering pines and thick undergrowth.
Earthy mulch and fallen leaves cushion your steps beneath canopy boughs.
woods: Gnarled oak and birch trees growing wild in the botanical simulation tract.
Sunlight filters in dappled patterns through thick foliage.
grove: A quiet secluded clearing enclosed by tall sylvan growth.
Soft moss carpets the ground in this wooded sanctuary.
ruins: Ancient weather-worn masonry and cracked subterranean tiles.
Shadowy flagstones strewn with rubble from fallen arches.
dungeon: Heavy iron-bound masonry and barred holding cells forming a test labyrinth.
Chiseled dungeon blocks chilled by damp air.
crypt: Cold stone sarcophagi and forgotten burial niches lined with dust.
Silent tomb corridors echoing with your footsteps.
outpost: Fortified timber bastions, earthen ramparts, and defensive perimeter works.
A militarized settlement frontier designed for garrison drills.
barracks: Bunk frames, weapon racks, and drilling yards within the outpost stockade.
Sturdy barracks halls built for regimented frontier troops.
fort: Reinforced battlements providing tactical vantage points across open terrain.
Stonework bastions with arrow slits and reinforced palisades.
ashlands: Volcanic ash plains strewn with blackened basalt and jagged pumice crags.
Pungent sulfur winds whip fine grey ash across the desolate terrain.
crags: Steep rocky ridges and razor-sharp obsidian outcroppings.
Treacherous rocky fissures jutting through the volcanic dust.
cave: Rough-hewn subterranean rock walls dripping with mineral moisture.
Cold stalactites hang from the low vaulted limestone ceiling.
cavern: An expansive underground chamber opening into deep rocky hollows.
Shadows stretch across jagged boulders in the cavern gloom.
water: Pure fresh water flowing through cut stone channels, perfect for drinking and washing.
Clear water rippling over clean river stones.
wash: A dedicated cleansing station fitted with stone scrub-boards and fresh water.
Abundant water suited for scouring soil and stains from garments.
river: A briskly coursing stream of cool upland runoff.
Rushing currents carving smooth channels through stone embankments.
lake: A calm reflective pool bordered by reeds and smooth pebbles.
Still, clear waters reflecting the atmospheric dome overhead.
house: Warm cedar floorboards and plastered walls representing domestic living spaces.
Quaint home furnishings creating a comfortable domestic interior.
cottage: A rustic single-room homestead with a stone hearth and cozy wood trim.
Simple rural architecture built for domestic simulation.
walkway: A dedicated pedestrian footpath flanked by guide markers.
Smooth paved flagstones marking a clear transit route.
gate: An arched checkpoint portal connecting neighboring districts.
A tall gate threshold marking district boundaries.
facility: Industrial laboratory masonry reinforced with brass conduit runs.
High-tech containment architecture housing experimental systems.
